description: Puntos de recolección de Aparatos eléctricos y electrónicos en el departamento Norte de Santander is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Gobernación de Norte de Santander, Norte de Santander. Este conjunto de datos describe cada uno de los puntos de recepción donde se han realizado las jornadas de recolección de residuos postconsumo en el departamento Norte de Santander. Coverage: Gobernación de Norte de Santander, Norte de Santander. The portal files it under the publisher Gobernación de Norte de Santander, Norte de Santander. Its tags are puntos de recepción, posconsumo, residuos eléctricos y electrónicos, ambiente, puntos de recolección. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible. The portal shows 2021-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
